_comment: Heart-rate zone edges, as fractions of max HR, read by src/analytics/zones.py (TRIMP, PMC, intensity split) and frontend/src/lib/hrZones.ts. One file so the server and the browser never bucket the same sample differently. Z2's upper edge is set near the aerobic threshold (~78% of max) so that z1+z2 corresponds to the `zone1_2` bucket every framework's intensity_distribution is written in — under the previous Friel 60/70/80/90 edges, honest Zone 2 work at 72% was counted as `zone3`, inverting Uphill Athlete's core diagnostic. Bump `version` when the edges change: cached per-workout zone metrics are keyed on it.
